title: Meh
text:
I used to have a barkbox subscription for a previous dog, and I loved it. The package was always inviting, and they would send a random assortment of fun and practical dog items, with explanations and values for each thing. When I got a new dog, I decided to sign back up. The assortment is no longer random. It is very formulaic now. Always 2 toys, 2 bags of treats and one chew. Based on their shop, the toys are valued at $10, treats at $5 and chew at $3, making it worth only $33, wjen you pay $35 and they claim its worth $45+.

I love the idea of bark box, and I love what it used to be, but I can't justify it now.
label: neutral
